# mcloud secrets

<!-- Generated by `go run ./internal/gendocs`: edit the source it names, not this file. -->

_Generated from the command's help in `internal/cli`._

[All commands](README.md)

An app's secrets: environment variables for all its functions.

Secrets reach every function of the app as environment variables (the
SDKs' secret("NAME") reads one). They live in the Secret app-secrets in the
app's namespace, for GitOps and direct apps alike: nothing to commit, no
keys to hold. The maxcloud controller keeps an encrypted copy and puts it
back after a cluster rebuild.

Setting or removing one restarts the app's HTTP and queue functions, so
they have it right away (--no-restart: on their next start). Scheduled
functions get it on their next run.

Run these in the app's repo, or name the app with --app.

| Command | |
| --- | --- |
| [`mcloud secrets list`](#mcloud-secrets-list) | List the app's secrets (names only) |
| [`mcloud secrets migrate`](#mcloud-secrets-migrate) | Move a GitOps app's secrets from secrets.sops.yaml in git to the cluster |
| [`mcloud secrets set`](#mcloud-secrets-set) | Set a secret; the value comes from stdin (or a hidden prompt) |
| [`mcloud secrets unset`](#mcloud-secrets-unset) | Remove a secret |

## mcloud secrets list

List the app's secrets (names only).

```
mcloud secrets list [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--app` string |  | the app (default: $MCLOUD\_APP, else maxcloud.yaml's) |

## mcloud secrets migrate

Move a GitOps app's secrets from secrets.sops.yaml in git to the cluster.

GitOps apps used to keep their secrets SOPS-encrypted in
deploy/k8s/secrets.sops.yaml. This takes over the Secret Flux decrypted
from it (so no key is needed), keeps Flux from deleting it, and removes the
file from the repo: commit and push that.

```
mcloud secrets migrate
```

## mcloud secrets set

Set a secret; the value comes from stdin (or a hidden prompt).

```
mcloud secrets set NAME [flags]
```

Examples:

```fish
mcloud secrets set STRIPE_KEY            # asks for the value
op read op://vault/stripe/key | mcloud secrets set STRIPE_KEY
```

Flags:

| Flag | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--app` string |  | the app (default: $MCLOUD\_APP, else maxcloud.yaml's) |
| `--no-restart` |  | don't restart the functions; they get the change when they next start |

## mcloud secrets unset

Remove a secret.

```
mcloud secrets unset NAME [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--app` string |  | the app (default: $MCLOUD\_APP, else maxcloud.yaml's) |
| `--no-restart` |  | don't restart the functions; they get the change when they next start |
